articles.author: Newsfile Corp.
articles.headline: Zhibao Technology Inc. Announces Signing a Non-Binding Term Sheet for Approximately 3,500 Bitcoins as Consideration for PIPE Financing
articles.summary: Zhibao announced a nonbinding financing outline involving approximately 3,500 bitcoin. Definitive agreements, valuation, custody, diligence and approvals remained outstanding; the publication does not establish that financing or a proposed control change completed.
